messages:
nina (release-ENG): FYI: Rolling deploy v2.5.0 tonight. Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Start 21:45 UTC. Primary concerns: APAC warm pool low, EU session spike risk. Need preflight capacity numbers and a borrow/backstop plan.

sam (infra): Current reserved GPUs: US 520, EU 280, APAC 140. After warmup cushion: US ~22%, EU ~12%, APAC ~8%. APAC looks underbooked.

leo (sre): If APAC <10% cushion at ramp, plan A: hold APAC at 0% and route to nearest region. Plan B: borrow up to 40 GPUs from US warm pool for the APAC warmup window (expected 30-45m). We can automate borrow with the warm-pool script.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 1759999999. Canary: us-central, 5% traffic, model v2.5.0-canary. I will post metric snaps every 3m. Abort: reply "deploy-bot abort" or react :x:.

min (qa): I'll run quick evals on the top-200 prompts during US canary. Thresholds: quality drift <= 4%, latency p95 <= 230ms, error rate < 0.6%. If any fail, we stop and snapshot diffs.

nina (release-ENG): Decision tree:
- If US canary OK -> US ramp to 60% then hold 20m.
- If US stable -> start EU 10% canary.
- APAC remains drained until EU p95 < 240ms and cushion >12% or borrow approved.

sam (infra): Borrow mechanism: run `scripts/borrow_warmpool --from us --to apac --count 40 --duration 45m`. Need approval from release-ENG channel (nina).

leo (sre): Added extra guard: autoscaler lower-bound for APAC set to 120 GPUs during ramp window. If fallback triggers, we pin APAC to v2.4.5-quantized and shift new sessions to EU.

deploy-bot: Canary heartbeat: t+3m metrics posted. US canary p95=210ms, error_rate=0.12%, q-diff=+0.8% (core prompts). No abort signal.

min (qa): Quick evals passed on core slices. One non-core slice +6% drift (investigating), not blocker.

nina (release-ENG): Approve borrow? I give conditional yes if US cushion stays >=15% after borrow. Sam, run the script and post results.

sam (infra): Borrow started at 1760000120. Transferred 36 GPUs (40 requested, 4 failed due to AZ imbalance). Post-borrow cushion: US 16%, EU 11%, APAC 15%.

leo (sre): Good. Start APAC warmup at 00:30 UTC but keep APAC traffic at 0% until we confirm warm cache hit rates > 80% and p95 <= 260ms.

deploy-bot: EU canary scheduled at 1760000400 if US holdpoint passes. Logging state changes.

min (qa): Keep an eye on the non-core slice. If it regresses >8% after EU ramp, we put EU on hold and pin to v2.4.5-lite.

nina (release-ENG): Rollback plan summarized in the runbook: immediate pin commands, stop new sessions in affected region, promote previous model tag, and open incident ticket. Rollback window: first 4 hours post-final roll. Postmortem required within 72h on any rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary complete at t+35m. US canary green. Posting final canary artifacts. Next: US ramp to 60% starting now.
